name: Six-method six-scenario PyTorch-SB3-SUMO systematic matrix
scope: Matched comparison of SAC, PPO, MST, MST+SLT, TemporalGraph, and Full+BalancedSlots over all six released or reconstructed SUMO scenarios, with three training seeds and 50 deterministic held-out episodes per trained policy.

matrix_contract.budget_rule: A result root contains one explicitly selected profile. Profiles may never be pooled or substituted for one another.
matrix_contract.evaluation_pairing: For a fixed scenario and training seed, every method uses the same evaluation seed start (training_seed + 10000), ordered held-out traffic partition, episode limit, and deterministic action rule.

predeclared_comparisons.interpretation: Effect of the released hierarchical scene encoder relative to the reconstructed recurrent SAC baseline under the same off-policy clock.
Effect of the one-step SLT auxiliary objective with the MST encoder held fixed.
Effect of delaying temporal pooling until after per-frame vehicle interaction, together with structured Graph-SLT.
Joint incremental effect of topology query and balanced latent slots. This comparison does not identify either component alone.
End-to-end comparison of the retained stabilized full method against the closest released MST+SLT baseline.
Cross-family on-policy versus off-policy baseline comparison; not a single-component ablation.

development_50k.evidence_scope: Systematic development screen only; it cannot be relabeled as a 100k paper-budget or 1M source-budget result.

paper.evidence_scope: Three-seed controlled matrix at the paper's 100k raw-step budget with the user-selected 10k checkpoint interval; seed count intentionally follows the requested matrix rather than the paper's five-seed report.

source_release_1m.evidence_scope: Three-seed confirmation at the released configuration's 1M raw-step default. The 100k checkpoint interval is storage-aware and does not alter optimization or final-policy selection.

environment_anchor.algorithm_clock_exception: PPO retains the audited released-source raw-tick rollout clock (environment_action_repeat=1); forcing 3 would define a different PPO baseline. All off-policy methods use Full+BalancedSlots action_repeat=3.

environment_protocol_rationale.ego_control_profile: Matches the completed topology-development experiments and preserves their direct TraCI action semantics.
environment_protocol_rationale.traffic_protocol: Every fifth released traffic XML is frozen for evaluation and excluded from training; all methods receive the same ordered partitions.
environment_protocol_rationale.episode_limit_profile: Matches the source-limit contract used by the topology-development experiments.
environment_protocol_rationale.carla_extension: The CARLA task is a SUMO reconstruction. SAC-on-CARLA and MST-on-CARLA are controlled matrix extensions because the paper did not report those two cells.

scenario_labels.carla: CARLA Town-10 task recreated in SUMO

sac.fidelity: Transparent reconstruction of the dormant released STATE_LSTM contract using GRU(256)+Dense(256); it does not consume candidate maps, MST, or SLT.

ppo.fidelity: Released-source PPO data flow: SMARTS tasks use a current RGB frame and CNN; CARLA uses the vector GRU/relation-attention policy with a three-tick internal action hold.

mst.fidelity: Released hierarchical scene representation and source SAC with SLT disabled before construction.

mst_slt.fidelity: Released MST hierarchical scene representation, one-step SLT auxiliary objective, and source SAC.

temporal_graph.fidelity: Per-frame vehicle interaction and structured Graph-SLT without topology query.

full_balanced.fidelity: Topology query, per-frame temporal vehicle graph, structured Graph-SLT, and non-affine normalization of the 32/64/32 latent slots.

fairness_contract.ppo_exception: PPO retains its released on-policy optimizer, 512-step rollout, RGB/vector observation branch, and one-raw-step environment clock; it is a baseline, not a single-variable ablation.
fairness_contract.final_checkpoint_rule: Use the source-recoverable last periodic checkpoint at the requested raw-step budget. Never select a checkpoint by held-out test performance.

statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction over the five predeclared comparisons against or within the MST family for each primary metric; PPO-minus-SAC remains descriptive.

artifact_contract.unknown_cell_rule: An incomplete cell is emitted as TBD with its machine status; no metric is imputed from another profile, seed, method, or predecessor run.

policy_selection_artifacts.primary: Last periodic checkpoint at the selected profile budget.
policy_selection_artifacts.secondary: A prospectively captured latest-20 training-success checkpoint may be retained but cannot replace the primary matrix result.
policy_selection_artifacts.reporting: Primary and secondary selections must be labeled and analyzed separately.

known_limits: SUMO equivalence is not bitwise SMARTS or CARLA physics equivalence.
The released repository omits a complete selectable plain-SAC entry point; SAC uses the audited v2 reconstruction.
SAC-on-CARLA and MST-on-CARLA are controlled extensions absent from the paper tables.
TemporalGraph versus Full+BalancedSlots jointly changes topology query and slot normalization, so that contrast alone cannot attribute a gain to topology.
The three training seeds are user-requested and do not reproduce the paper's five-seed sampling uncertainty.
